The place for burning {{item|corpse}}s is used to cremate corpses in the [[crematorium]] which can be found south of the [[morgue]] entrance. Cremated corpses will leave behind a {{item|burial certificate}}, some [[ash]] and [[salt]]. Places for burning can only be used for one cremation. This tech is unlocked in the [[Theology_(Tech_Tree)|theology tech tree]] under the graves category.
